info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Preapprovals-v3-spec
info.description: The List Mortgage Loan Preapprovals API allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of preapproval statuses for mortgage loans. This endpoint is designed for financial institutions and lenders to efficiently manage and assess potential borrowers' preapproved mortgage applications. By utilizing this API, developers can integrate preapproval data into their applications, facilitating better decision-making processes. Typical use cases include checking the eligibility of clients, tracking application statuses, and generating reports on preapproval trends.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to check the preapproval status for a loan application. It provides the necessary details about eligibility and conditions for loan preapproval based on user-provided criteria.

requestBody.description: Request body for obtaining preapproval information regarding loans. This should contain the necessary parameters to evaluate the preapproval eligibility.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the preapproval operation in the loans service. It is expected to be a string representation of the JSON request body.
